verification_scope.github_actions: Hosted baseline 0f7e76f: Ubuntu, macOS and Windows candidate harness jobs passed; trusted-controller and aggregate verify jobs failed. Later candidate results belong in their exact-revision CI reports.

verification_scope.app_server_transport: Python stdlib UTF-8 stdio runner accepts only qualified codex-cli 0.161.0 and 0.162.1. Existing runs retain their exact executable path/hash/version and harness/profile policy. Deterministic subprocess tests exercise both accepted versions, strict rejection, unchanged settings and owned cleanup; workflow tests reject runtime drift without replacing sessions or Goal accounting.
verification_scope.native_goal_and_specification_qa: Independent disposable probes passed typed ordinary-turn Q&A, native automatic Goal continuation, same-thread reconnect/accounting and pause/interruption. Production transport/preflight and status-only reactivation were then observed: zero client continuation turns after reconnect, two native turns with real local checks, and bounded paused shutdown. See .rdd/evidence/runtime-qualification-20261009/production-smoke/FINAL_FINDINGS.json; prior native reviewer inheritance failure remains preserved.
verification_scope.readonly_resolution: Separate independent disposable qualification passed canonical profile-applied explicitly read-only threads, actual EPERM write denial, persistent review snapshots/reconnect, distinct final reviewer, and coordinator-only experimental dynamic tool callback correlation/resume. Inherited approval policy/reviewer unchanged. See .rdd/evidence/runtime-qualification-20261009/reviewer-isolation/FINAL_FINDINGS.json.
verification_scope.public_workflow_acceptance: Three-command runner behavior is covered by offline tests with simulated Codex/GitHub protocols. Native end-to-end execution/acceptance of the public workflow commands and Todo/product acceptance have not been demonstrated.
verification_scope.codex_01621: Disposable macOS arm64 qualification passed actual production transport/preflight, typed specification question/answer handling, canonical native specialist delegation, explicit read-only reviewer write denial and correlated callbacks across reconnect. Generated-schema validation covered the exercised RPCs. Native Goal reactivation and subsequent continuation required zero client continuation turns; identity/accounting, pause/interruption and complete legacy/paginated history checks passed. An unused legacy session was unavailable after reconnect; recovery preserved its recorded ID and stopped without replacement. No Todo or native public-workflow acceptance was claimed.
